# Test fixtures

| File | Origin |
|---|---|
| `nifty_*.json`, `banknifty_*.json` | **Synthetic** chains in the exact NSE option-chain JSON layout, generated by `scripts/make_fixtures.py` (Black-76 with realistic put skew and OI). The repo ships no exchange market data. |
| `kite_NFO_sample.csv`, `kite_BFO_sample.csv` | Subset of the public Kite instruments dump (contract metadata only) taken on 21 Nov 2026 - includes the NIFTY 24-Nov holiday shift and the SENSEX 20 -> 25 lot transition. |
| `bhavcopy_NSE_FO_20261120_sample.csv` | **Synthetic** rows in the NSE UDiFF F&O bhavcopy column layout. |
| `kotak_neo_scrip_master_sample.csv` | **Synthetic** rows in the Kotak Neo scrip-master column layout (1980-epoch expiry for nse_fo, strikes in paise). |
